sources.finding: Travel volume, fuel mix, energy efficiency and electrification affect greenhouse-gas emissions; no numerical savings added.
Exhaust and wear particles from brakes, tyres and road surfaces are distinct sources.
Tyre-road interaction dominates at higher speeds; quieter electric propulsion does not eliminate all noise.
7 January 2026 notice confirms revised weighting for new registrations from 2026, reflecting electric and combustion operation; no journey-consumption guarantee.
Correct tyre pressure, speed limits and removing unused roof equipment are recommended. No fixed percentage saving or universal gear/engine-speed claim.

Chapter 3 sections 2 and 14 support following distance and safe speed/control.
